{{Quote|I trust you will find what you seek.|The henchman, welcoming Dooku to the Cauldron's arena battles|translated=1|audio=Henchman1.flac|<ref name="Location" />}}
A [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] '''henchman''' of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems']] [[Head of State/Legends|leader]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Administrator/Legends|administered]] [[the Cauldron]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] arena on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The henchman provided Dooku with combatants in the [[Count/Legends|count's]] search for a new minion. However, as the henchman viewed the gladiators alongside Dooku, the host was suddenly [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] hopeful [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], whom Dooku was nevertheless pleased to accept as his new [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolyte]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Impressive. ''[&hellip;]'' You have great skill of infiltration. My host would applaud your abilities posthumously.|Dooku, noticing the assassination of the henchman|audio=Henchman2.flac|<ref name="Location" />}}
[[File:Henchman_welcome.png|thumb|left|300px|The henchman welcomes Count Dooku to the Cauldron gladiator arena.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] served as an [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of<ref name="CW6" /> [[the Cauldron]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] pit<ref name="CSWE-Cauldron">{{CSWECite|I|112|Cauldron, the}}</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]].<ref name="Rattatak DB">{{DB|location|rattatak|Rattatak}}</ref> A henchman of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]],<ref name="CW6" /> a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] and the [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="CSWE Dooku">{{CSWECite|I|198|Dooku, Count}}</ref> the administrator welcomed Dooku to the arena<ref name="CW6" /> prior to [[22 BBY/Legends|21.95 BBY]], by four [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] into the war.<ref name="Date" /> Dooku had arrived in [[Mission to Rattatak|search]] of a new minion among that [[Standard day/Legends|day's]] gladiatorial contestants.<ref name="CW6" />

Having requested in advance for the Cauldron to be arranged in a particular manner, Dooku arrived aboard his [[Count Dooku's solar sailer/Legends|solar sailer]] and was greeted by the henchman, who promised him that everything had been prepared as desired. The administrator then led the guest into the arena for a personal viewing of the gladiatorial matches, wherein several combatants demonstrated their prowess before the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].<ref name="CW6" />

Reaching a viewing box high above the Cauldron arena, Dooku and his henchman seated themselves and observed the battles below together. The two were watching the arena matches when the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] hopeful [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] suddenly infiltrated their box and silently<ref name="CW6" /> [[Death/Legends|slew]] the henchman,<ref name="Card">{{Topps|set=2004 Topps Star Wars: Clone Wars|cardname=40 - The New Combatant|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/82456/cid/5864268/2004-Topps-Star-Wars:-Clone-Wars-40-The-new-combatant}}</ref> placing herself in the seat next to [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku in the host's stead. Dooku nevertheless noticed the act, commenting that Ventress's victim would praise her skills of infiltration, albeit posthumously. After Ventress proceeded to demonstrate her own abilities by defeating all of the Cauldron's gladiators, Dooku was satisfied to accept the henchman's killer as his new [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolyte]].<ref name="CW6" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''&laquo;''Everything has been arranged precisely as you have requested&hellip;most illustrious Count Dooku.''&raquo;<br />"''Indeed.|The henchman and Count Dooku|audio=Henchman3.flac|noquote=1|<ref name="CW6" />}}
[[File:RattatakWrestlemania-CW6.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Count Dooku and his henchman observed the arena battles from a private box.]]
The [[Gender/Legends|man]]<ref name="Hyperspace commentary" /> spoke with a deep voice a non-[[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] [[Language/Legends|language]] that Count Dooku understood. In addition, while hosting Dooku at the Cauldron arena, the henchman maintained a constant grin on<ref name="CW6" /> his<ref name="Hyperspace commentary" /> [[Color/Legends|blue-gray]] face, which also featured a pair of large, green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="CW6" />

==Equipment==
The henchman donned a beige [[Robe/Legends|robe]] held in place over the left shoulder by three triangular khaki pins. A tall [[Clothing/Legends|headdress]] crowned the tight-fitting hood attached to the humanoid's largely unembellished robe.<ref name="CW6" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We first recorded American&mdash;normal dialogue for him, English dialogue, but then I remember always seeing subtitles when aliens speak&mdash;kinda cool and feels like a real language, feels more authentic&mdash;so we ended up re-dubbing him and putting subtitles.|''Clone Wars'' director Genndy Tartakovsky|<ref name="Hyperspace commentary" />}}
The henchman appears in "[[Chapter 6 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|Chapter 6]]" of the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' animated series.<ref name="CW6" /> The episode first aired on [[November 14]], [[2003]] on [[Cartoon Network]]<ref name="TVcom">{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-clone-wars/chapter-vi-276612|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars - Season 1, Episode 6: Chapter VI}}</ref> and features [[Daran Norris]] providing the character's voice. The arena host was later identified as "Henchman" in the ''Clone Wars'' cast-and-crew list published on [[StarWars.com]] on [[March 22]], [[2004]].<ref name="Cast & Crew">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/microseries/castcrew.html|text=''Clone Wars'' Cast & Crew}}</ref> According to ''Clone Wars'' director [[Genndy Tartakovsky]], the henchman originally had his lines spoken in English, but this was re-dubbed as Tartakovsky thought it would be aesthetically better and in keeping with the ''[[Star Wars]]'' movie tradition for the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] to speak in a made-up language and have on-screen subtitles for audiences to read instead.<ref name="Hyperspace commentary" />
